| Item | Recommendation |
|------|----------------|
| **Fuel Tank Capacity** | Check your vehicle’s fuel tank size (often 12–15 gal). |
| **Average MPG** | Estimate your car’s average miles‑per‑gallon (e.g., 25 mpg). |
| **Fuel Needed** | 980 mi ÷ 25 mpg ≈ 39 gal. |
| **Stops** | Plan for at least 2–3 refueling stops (most highways have service stations every 60–80 mi). |
| **Extra Fuel** | Keep an extra 5–10 gal in reserve for detours or emergencies. |

If your tank holds 12 gal, you’ll need to refuel about **3–4 times** during the trip. Make sure to check the fuel prices along your route and consider using a navigation app that highlights gas stations and their prices. Safe travels!
